description: Core GBP operational task library v1. IMMUTABLE once used — create v2 for changes.

templates.title: Publish weekly GBP post
templates.instructions:
1. Open the prepared post in the Content tab for this location (status: Ready).
2. Open the GBP listing > Add update.
3. Paste the post text exactly as written. Do not edit the wording.
4. Attach the image described in the media brief.
5. Add the CTA button and paste the tracked CTA URL.
6. Publish, then paste the live post URL as evidence and mark the content item Published.
templates.definition_of_done: Post is live on the profile, uses the prepared text/CTA/tracked URL, live URL recorded as evidence, content item marked Published.

templates.title: Reply to all outstanding reviews
templates.instructions:
1. Open the GBP reviews tab and list every review without an owner response.
2. For each one, use the prepared reply from the Content tab (type: Review reply). If no reply is prepared, request one and set this task to Waiting.
3. Paste the reply exactly. Never argue, never share personal data, never admit legal liability.
4. For 1-2 star reviews: do NOT reply without operator approval — flag them.
5. Record the number of replies posted and screenshot one example as evidence.
templates.definition_of_done: Zero unanswered reviews older than 2 working days; 1-2 star reviews escalated, not self-answered; evidence attached.

templates.title: Escalate and respond to negative review
templates.instructions:
1. Screenshot the review and attach it as 'before' evidence.
2. Check whether the review violates Google policy (spam, fake, off-topic, conflict of interest). If it does, flag it via 'Report review' and record the date.
3. Use the prepared response once approved. Do not improvise a reply.
4. Notify the operator so the client can be informed.
templates.definition_of_done: Review screenshotted, policy check recorded, approved reply posted (or report submitted), operator notified.

templates.title: Send review request batch
templates.instructions:
1. Get the location's review link (GBP > Ask for reviews) and confirm it opens the correct listing.
2. Use the prepared outreach message from the Content tab.
3. Send to the customer list supplied by the client (target: 20 contacts).
4. Record: number sent, channel used, date. Never offer incentives for reviews.
templates.definition_of_done: Review link verified, prepared message sent to the agreed list, send count recorded as evidence.

templates.title: Upload monthly photo set
templates.instructions:
1. Collect the approved photo set per the media brief (target: 6 photos — 2 exterior/on-site, 2 team/service-in-progress, 2 completed work).
2. Rename files descriptively before upload (e.g. fire-door-installation-croydon-july.jpg).
3. Upload via GBP > Photos, correct category for each.
4. Screenshot the uploaded set as 'after' evidence.
templates.definition_of_done: Six approved photos live on the profile in the correct categories, screenshots attached.

templates.title: Add Q&A entry to profile
templates.instructions:
1. Open the prepared Q&A pair from the Content tab.
2. Post the question from the client's account (or note it for the client to post), then post the prepared answer from the business profile.
3. Also check existing public questions — answer any unanswered ones using prepared content only.
4. Screenshot as evidence.
templates.definition_of_done: Prepared Q&A live on the profile; no unanswered public questions remain; screenshot attached.

templates.title: Set special hours for upcoming holiday
templates.instructions:
1. Confirm holiday opening hours with the operator/client notes.
2. GBP > Edit profile > Hours > Special hours: add the holiday dates.
3. Screenshot the saved special hours as evidence.
templates.definition_of_done: Special hours saved for every upcoming public holiday within 14 days, screenshot attached.

templates.title: Weekly profile data check
templates.instructions:
1. Open the public listing and the GBP editor side by side.
2. Check for Google-suggested edits, pending changes, or values that changed without our change log entry (name, category, phone, website, hours, address).
3. If anything changed unexpectedly: screenshot it, DO NOT fix it yourself, create a change record and escalate to the operator.
4. Confirm the listing is not suspended and no re-verification is requested.
templates.definition_of_done: Checklist run; any unexpected change screenshotted and escalated with a change record; 'no changes' explicitly recorded otherwise.

templates.title: Check and answer new public questions
templates.instructions:
1. Open the Q&A section of the public listing.
2. For each unanswered question, use a prepared answer if one matches; otherwise request content and set this task to Waiting.
3. Screenshot answered questions as evidence.
templates.definition_of_done: No public question older than 2 working days without a business answer.

templates.title: Correct inconsistent citation
templates.instructions:
1. Open the directory listing named in this task.
2. Compare name, address and phone against the master values on the location record — the location record is the source of truth.
3. Correct or request correction. Record the submission date and expected turnaround.
4. Screenshot before and after.
templates.definition_of_done: Citation matches master NAP exactly, or a correction request is logged with date; before/after evidence attached.

templates.title: Update services on profile
templates.instructions:
1. Use the prepared service list/descriptions from the Content tab.
2. GBP > Edit services: add each missing service under the correct category. Paste descriptions exactly.
3. Do not remove existing services unless the task says so.
4. Screenshot the final services screen.
templates.definition_of_done: All services from the prepared list are live with their descriptions; screenshot attached.

templates.title: Update business description
templates.instructions:
1. Copy the current description into a change record as the previous value.
2. Paste the approved prepared description from the Content tab (max 750 characters).
3. Save and screenshot.
templates.definition_of_done: Approved description live, previous value stored in the change log, screenshot attached.

templates.title: Change primary/secondary category
templates.instructions:
SENSITIVE CHANGE — requires operator approval before touching the profile.
1. Record the current categories in a change record (previous value).
2. Apply only the approved category change. Change nothing else in the same session.
3. Screenshot before and after. Note the date — rankings must be observed for the following 4 weeks.
templates.definition_of_done: Approved category live, change record complete with before/after, no other edits made the same day.

templates.title: Fix/replace website link with tracked URL
templates.instructions:
1. Record the current website URL in a change record.
2. Replace with the approved landing-page URL including UTM parameters.
3. Click the link on the live listing to verify it resolves to the right page.
4. Screenshot before and after.
templates.definition_of_done: Tracked location-page URL live and verified working; change record complete.

templates.title: Record monthly GBP performance metrics
templates.instructions:
1. Open GBP > Performance for last month.
2. Enter calls, website clicks, direction requests, bookings, review count and rating into the location's metric snapshot form (source: Manual).
3. Add lead counts from the client/CRM if available.
templates.definition_of_done: A metric snapshot exists for the month with source=manual; gaps noted in the snapshot notes.

templates.title: Investigate possible duplicate listing
templates.instructions:
1. Search Maps for the business name, phone and address variants; screenshot every listing found.
2. DO NOT merge, close or report anything yourself.
3. Compile findings (URLs + screenshots) and escalate to the operator with a recommendation.
templates.definition_of_done: All candidate duplicates documented with URLs and screenshots; escalated; no destructive action taken by the VA.
